query: UPDATE notification_webhooks SET name = COALESCE($3, name), url = COALESCE($4, url), format = COALESCE($5, format), kinds = COALESCE($6, kinds), project_id = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE project_id END, enabled = COALESCE($9, enabled), disabled_reason = CASE WHEN $9 IS NULL THEN disabled_reason ELSE NULL END, consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN $9 THEN 0 ELSE consecutive_failures END, updated_at = $10 WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
